answer: Approximately 5.6% (1 out of 18) of original studies in Experimental Economics were conducted in the United Kingdom.

payload.hypothesis: Approximately 5.6% (1 out of 18) of the original studies in Experimental Economics were conducted in the United Kingdom.
payload.workflow: Filtered the main meta-regression study dataset to project=='ee' (Experimental Economics), yielding 18 rows. Counted distinct original studies by the study key `id` as the denominator (18). Counted those with experiment_country.o == 'United Kingdom' as the numerator (1). In this subset there are no missing country values and no duplicate original studies (each id, title and authors.o is unique), so no imputation or deduplication was needed. Proportion = 1/18 ≈ 0.0556, i.e. about 5.6%.
